ScratchStepPace.reason: its steps only leave a note

slow.reason: the step paced by its name

ScratchStepPaceAfter.reason: its first step only leaves a note

arm.reason: its timer fires 3 s after it, inside the wait after it

ScratchUntilExpression.reason: each step's until holds 0.3 s of game time after it

scaled.reason: its until holds at 0.6 s of game time, 1.2 s of real time at time_scale 0.5

ScratchUntilReleased.reason: its last step only leaves a note

hold.reason: its until holds once the test writes the release file; the pace is only its cap

known.ScratchLeak: leaks a node at exit on purpose, so the runner's leak check has a scene to find
